newsitem.title: USA: Apple Chairman Amelio resigns, Jobs to expand role.
newsitem.headline: Apple Chairman Amelio resigns, Jobs to expand role.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc. Chairman and Chief Executive Gilbert Amelio resigned Wednesday after struggling for 17 months to return the company to profitability.

The company said it had begun looking for a new CEO. Until one is found, Steve Jobs, the ousted Apple co-founder who returned in December to advise Amelio, will "assume an expanded role as a key adviser to Apple's board and executive team," Apple said.
